contributions.basis: cover-line1-this (bare dash, i.e. nothing new this period)
contributions.detail: Form A (p2) is entirely blank at 90 dpi and at 170 dpi normalized — an EMPTY SCHEDULE, zero rows, an honest zero. Cover line 1 reads 1521. in TOTALS FROM LAST REPORT, a bare DASH in TOTALS FOR THIS REPORT, and 1521. in CUMULATIVE, so LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE closes and the blank schedule is consistent with 'nothing new this period'. But a bare dash is not a numeral, so there is NO numeric anchor to score a zero-row side against, and result is 'unknown' rather than 'exact'. HUMAN-VISIBLE CONSEQUENCE: the 1,521 of over-$50 contributions this filer reports CUMULATIVELY is not itemized ANYWHERE in this document — the detail behind it lives in an earlier report, which is not in this chunk. Do not read the blank Form A as 'no donors'. The Carr form prints no schedule total (null by form design). Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is a bare dash in all three columns.

expenditures.detail: Twenty itemized rows on Form B (p3), spanning 2009-03-15 to 2012-09-07, sum to EXACTLY 1267.00, which equals cover line 3 CUMULATIVE, printed '1,267.' (whole dollars, trailing period, no cents). This is unambiguously a CUMULATIVE (cycle-to-date) schedule: the rows cover four calendar years, and the LAST and THIS cells on line 3 are left entirely blank while only the CUMULATIVE cell is filled. The gate FIRED and CLOSED to the cent with no row adjusted. The Carr form prints no schedule total, so the cover line is the only anchor (null by form design).

gates.page_subtotal: No printed schedule or page subtotal on the Carr sheets (form design). Form B gated against the cover: the 20 transcribed amounts sum 50+50+150+143+55+50+56+50+50+200+30+50+56+25+50+47+60+50+25+20 = 1267.00 = cover line 3 CUMULATIVE '1,267.' — EXACT. Form A has no numeric anchor (cover line 1 THIS is a bare dash), so no gate could be run on that side; it is a blank schedule.
gates.row_count: p3 rowbands.py: geometry_status ok, 37 h-rules / 36 bands. Ink occupies bands 1-23; bands 24-36 are clean. Scored against INK, not blindly against bands: three of those 23 bands are NOT transactions — band 2 carries a date+payee whose purpose text wraps, band 4 carries only the wrapped purpose 'Membership dues' plus its amount (the filer drew an ARROW from 'NFIB' in band 3 down to it), band 11 carries only the wrapped purpose 'meals etc', and band 18 carries only the wrapped purpose 'meals, office exp.' plus a stray '?' and dash in the left columns. Net: 20 dated payee entries and 20 amounts -> 20 rows emitted. A hand-written filer note occupying three ruled lines further down ('Note: All travel exp. listed is unreimbursed travel in county.') is NOT a transaction and was not transcribed. p2 needs no band count: the page is empty at 170 dpi normalized.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first row's amount box (pct 83.50,9.04 -> 600dpi x=4260 y=595 W=520 H=185) renders '50.00'; last row's amount box (pct 83.50,60.16 -> y=3960 H=155) renders '20.00'; the control box one row-pitch below the last row (y=4115 H=150) renders EMPTY. Row indices additionally cross-checked band by band against the date/payee columns in eight half-width 600 dpi crops covering bands 1-23, so the one-band offset between payee and amount on rows 2 and 3 is a deliberate transcription of the filer's wrapped layout, not a shifted index.
gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY on the cumulative column: contributions 1521 - expenditures 1267 = 254, and cover line 4 CUMULATIVE is written '254.'. The LAST and THIS columns of lines 3 and 4 are blank, so no per-period chain can be checked. Cover identity LAST + THIS = CUMULATIVE closes on line 1 (1521 + nothing = 1521). No earlier filing by this filer is in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain could be run here; note that the sibling document 2012_st_Craig_W_Buttars_12_5_12_General.pdf exists in the module but is NOT in this chunk.

escalation_note: p3 read at 600 dpi in eight half-width band crops (dates+payees on the left, purposes+amounts on the right, four vertical bands each) so every row was re-read at roughly 3x the base full-page resolution; plus three single-cell geometry-proof crops at 600 dpi; plus the p1 cover money block in two 600 dpi crops (to separate the written figures from the bare dashes on lines 1-THIS and 2). p2 re-rendered at 170 dpi with -normalize to rule out faint pencil.
notes: Chunk file says candidate 'Craig W Buttars', office 'County Council'. The form agrees: 'Full Name of Candidate: Craig W Buttars', 'Name of Office: Cache County Council', 'Office District: North', party Republican, Date 10/30/12, clerk stamp 'CACHE COUNTY CLERK RCVD 30 OCT 2012 AM 10:58'. The 'TO' line reads 'Jill Zollinger, Cache'. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN PASSED but the page needs care: this filer's purpose text WRAPS onto the next ruled line, so on rows 2 and 3 the amount sits one band BELOW the payee, and on row 3 the filer drew an explicit ARROW from 'NFIB' to the 'Membership dues' line to bind them. Twenty payee entries and twenty amounts were counted independently and match; every date cell holds date-shaped content and every payee cell name-shaped content. Rows 16 and 17 are out of chronological order on the page (3/12/12 above 3/2/12); printed order is retained, per the line_no rule. A hand-drawn CHECK MARK sits to the right of the amount on rows 1-18 but NOT on rows 19 and 20 — the Carr form prints no such column, so these are someone's later ticks (filer or clerk) and are recorded here rather than as data. 'BSA' and 'UAC' are the filer's own abbreviations, kept verbatim. Candidate street address, ZIP and home phone are in the clear on the cover and were discarded at read time; Form B has no address column, so no donor/vendor addresses arise. IMPORTANT: Form A is blank while the cover carries a cumulative 1,521 of over-$50 contributions — see recon.contributions.detail.
